import gzip, os, re
from collections import defaultdict
species_map = {
 'Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.cdna.all.fa.gz': 'human',
 'Mus_musculus.GRCm39.cdna.all.fa.gz': 'mouse',
 'Sus_scrofa.Sscrofa11.1.cdna.all.fa.gz': 'pig',
}
for fn,sp in species_map.items():
    out_fa = 'refs/'+sp+'_longest.fa'
    out_tg = 'refs/'+sp+'_longest_tgmap.tsv'
    best={}  # gene_key -> (tid,seq,gene_id,sym)
    tid=None; gene_id=None; sym=None; seq=[]
    def flush():
        global tid,gene_id,sym,seq
        if tid:
            s=''.join(seq)
            key=gene_id
            if key not in best or len(s)>len(best[key][1]):
                best[key]=(tid,s,gene_id,sym)
    with gzip.open('refs/'+fn,'rt') as fin:
        for line in fin:
            if line.startswith('>'):
                flush(); tid=None; seq=[]
                header=line[1:].strip()
                if 'gene_biotype:protein_coding' not in header:
                    continue
                tid=header.split()[0]
                m_gene=re.search(r'gene:(\\S+)',header)
                m_sym=re.search(r'gene_symbol:(\\S+)',header)
                gene_id=m_gene.group(1) if m_gene else tid
                sym=m_sym.group(1) if m_sym else gene_id
            elif tid is not None:
                seq.append(line.strip())
        flush()
    with open(out_fa,'w') as fo, open(out_tg,'w') as tg:
        for key,(t,s,g,sym) in best.items():
            gene_key=f'{sp.upper()}__{g}__{sym}'
            fo.write('>'+t+'\\n')
            for i in range(0,len(s),80):
                fo.write(s[i:i+80]+'\\n')
            tg.write(f'{t}\\t{gene_key}\\n')
